title: Private & Secure Medical Data Transmission
summary: Secure QR-based patient data transmission and automated check-in.
details: Developed a secure system for medical data transmission using QR codes to ensure privacy and automate patient check-ins. It encrypts sensitive health records and allows seamless access through QR code scanning.

title: Online Quiz System
summary: Android application to create, save, and practice MCQs.
details: Built an Android app that allows users to create custom multiple-choice quizzes, save them locally using SQLite, and practice for exams with an intuitive mobile interface.

title: Portfolio Website
details: Designed and developed a responsive personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, and experience with modern design principles and semantic HTML.
